data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Live-evidence attach IS the SC-8 evidence. dd-5 attach step MUST run against REAL post-pass-8 state (not synthetic fixture); the resulting dd5.json artifact attached to epic 4047 via dso ticket CLI is the load-bearing SC-8 evidence. Add explicit AC for live-run mode: when --live flag passed, audit_dd5_bundle.sh reads dd*.json from .reconciler-audit-artifacts/<phase>/ which MUST have been written by live audit runs (not fixtures); fail-closed exit 8 if dd*.json files are detected as fixture-generated (e.g., test-only file marker). Story-closure verifier checks: epic 4047 has a comment whose body references a dd5.json artifact with overall_result=true AND --live mode marker. Rationale: validation-class closure cannot pass on synthetic fixtures (cross_task_interference).
